answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by forcing new identities to cross a computational dune that costs real energy per clone. Each agent earns a quartz-sealed key tied to one device, so copying it is impossible without repeating the work. A public orchard of attestations flags duplicates and slashes their stake on sight. Because every forged twin must repay the full setup cost, flooding the network with fakes only drains the attacker's capital.
